description: Heatwave and Data-Dependent Severe-Wind Forecast Reliability Specialist diagnosing separate threshold exceedance, peak temperature, onset timing, duration/persistence, warm nights, spatial extent, and gale gusts across Core Heatwave Zone, Northwest Plains, Coastal, and Hill regions.

invariants.decomposed_failure_modes: Threshold exceedance, peak temperature, onset, duration, warm nights, spatial extent, and severe wind are evaluated separately; never collapsed into an opaque single score.
invariants.anti_leakage: Uses strictly issue-time features available at t0; IMD gridded maximum/minimum temperature and ERA5 hourly gust observations sealed with 24h verification latency.
invariants.data_dependent_wind_activation: Severe wind evaluation is strictly activated on paired forecast/reference datasets meeting Gate 0 data availability contracts.
invariants.regional_conditioning: Performance certified across Core Heatwave Zone, Northwest Plains, Coastal Peninsular, and Hill Region domains.
